mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulmonary capillary sheet was most worthwhile: the planned close wrapping makes the thin exchange barrier tangible and connects its structure to diffusion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding elastic support was less satisfying because the picture shows the fibres but does not explain their function. The airway-tree result also adds little beyond the connection itself.

surprise.text: The surfactant explanation clarified why the lining matters: it helps prevent the sacs from collapsing as they become smaller.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt purposeless, but the elastic tissue’s role was left unexplained. The exchange explanation also invokes pressure gradients without explaining them, which may leave the connection to diffusion unclear.

continue.text: I would cautiously continue: the exchange surface and final circulation connection are interesting, though I would want more explanation of parts such as the elastic fibres.
